read.title: Updated Business Travel Policy
read.text:
To all staff,

Starting next month, all business trips must be approved by your team leader at least two weeks in advance. Once your trip is approved, the travel desk will book your flights and accommodation and send you a full itinerary.

During the trip, you will receive a per diem of 60 dollars for meals and local transportation. Hotel costs are paid directly by the company.

After you return, please submit an expense report with original receipts within seven days. Costs without receipts cannot be reimbursed.

Thank you for your cooperation.

HR Team

write.task: 다음 주 부산 출장이 잡혔어요. 총무팀에 출장 기간을 알리고, 행사장 근처 호텔 예약을 부탁하는 이메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Write an email to the admin team telling them your trip dates and asking them to book a hotel near the venue.
hints: I'll be out of the office from ... to ...
write.model:
Hi Jiyoung,

I'm going on a business trip to Busan next week for the beauty fair. I'll be out of the office from Wednesday to Friday. Could you book a hotel near the BEXCO venue for me? A single room for two nights would be fine. Please let me know if you need any other details.

Thanks,
Minsu
